name: asdair-handoff
description: BUILD-015 AsdAIr Stage 1 - the Sonnet browser handoff. Turns a Sonnet Browser Execution Packet into one durable artefact that is both phone-readable and machine-parseable, wraps the supervised step in a single-writer claim/progress/completion lifecycle over the EXISTING asdair.browser_build_request, and ingests what Sonnet reports back into the reconciler's input. It contains NO Sonnet trigger: Claude for Chrome has no programmatic invocation surface and none is invented here. Never checks out, never pays, never books a slot, never enters a credential, never substitutes.
